summary: Added optional VerdictRecord.role (discriminating|informational|None) with append_verdict validation and legacy replay. Judge enforces direction-homogeneous scopes, stamps per-gate roles per Q2/Q3, resolves PBO metrics to abs_sharpe/sharpe/neg_sharpe with the resolved name recorded in params, and runs DSR on negated series under less. Killer-demo aggregation counts only non-informational verdicts; report battery table gains a Role column and updated two-sided footnotes. Exported DeclarationRecord and SealRecord. New tests/test_judge_direction.py covers idle-gate, three-branch, mixed-direction, metric form guard, and ledger role round-trip.
